slides.title: Production readiness
slides.html:
Production

Production readiness

  • Config from env, validated at start
  • trust proxy behind Render
  • Graceful shutdown
  • No secrets or stack traces leaked

src/config.js

const env = z.object({
  NODE_ENV: z.enum(["development", "test", "production"]),
  PORT: z.coerce.number().default(5000),
  MONGO_URI: z.string().url(),
  JWT_SECRET: z.string().min(32),
  CLIENT_URL: z.string(),
}).parse(process.env); // crash early if something is missing
 
app.set("trust proxy", 1);

slides.title: Health check and graceful shutdown
slides.html:
Shutdown

Health check and graceful shutdown

  • /api/health for the host and you
  • Check the database too
  • Finish requests before exiting

src/server.js

app.get("/api/health", (req, res) => {
  const db = mongoose.connection.readyState === 1;
  res.status(db ? 200 : 503).json({ ok: db, uptime: process.uptime() });
});
 
const server = app.listen(env.PORT);
process.on("SIGTERM", () => {
  server.close(async () => {
    await mongoose.disconnect();
    process.exit(0);
  });
});

Atlas

MongoDB Atlas in production

Separate database

Use a new database name for prod, never your dev data.

.../capstone-prod

Least privilege

A DB user with readWrite on that database only.

not Atlas admin

Network access

Render IPs change: 0.0.0.0/0 + strong password, or paid static IPs.

plus backups

slides.title: A README that gets you hired
slides.html:
README

A README that gets you hired

  • What it does in one line
  • Live API and docs links
  • How to run and test
  • Architecture and decisions

README.md

# ShopAPI
REST API for a small online store: products, carts, orders and Paystack.
 
**Live:** https://shopapi.onrender.com · **Docs:** /api/docs
**Tests:** 42 passing, 81% coverage
 
## Stack
Express 5 · MongoDB · Zod · JWT · Paystack · Jest · Render
 
## Decisions
- Prices are stored in kobo as integers, never floats
- Orders are only marked paid by the verified Paystack webhook
